patterns.reproduced_strategy: order_idor: two authenticated sessions (owner + non-owner) read the same per-user order resource; cross-account access reproduced when the non-owner receives the owner's exact object (verified against the owner's authorized view).

coupon_abuse: a client-supplied coupon code the shop never issued is trusted and applied to the cart; reproduced when an in-scope order-status read-back shows the illegitimate discount durably persisted on the order.
